title: Retro x Racer
desc: Pilot a high-speed jet in Retro X Racer! Dodge infinite towers, collect credits, and grab power-ups to survive as long as you can. Use A/D or Arrow Keys to steer and set the highest score.
howto: Controls A or Left Arrow Key Move Left D or Right Arrow Key Move Right
tips: Brake before sharp turns, then accelerate out cleanly.
Use small steering corrections at high speed.
Learn the first track pattern before chasing risky shortcuts.
